name: blanewarrene-marketplace
description: Operating systems and skills for product, operations, and AI-forward leaders. Built by Blane Warrene.

plugins.name: product-in-acquisitions-os
plugins.description: An operating system for product leaders accountable for post-acquisition integration outcomes. Walks acquiring-company product leaders through the 90-day framework: Week 0 readiness, roadmap convergence, market positioning stability, and people integration.

plugins.name: job-interview-meeting-preparation
plugins.description: Prepare for a high-stakes meeting by first choosing which one it is: an interview, a peer or stakeholder, an operator, or a board member or other CxO. Researches the company and stakeholder, tailors the conversation to that meeting type, and produces an in-conversation brief and a printable HTML and PDF one-pager. Run a series of meetings inside a Claude Project so each brief builds on the last.

plugins.name: comparative-landscape-brief
plugins.description: Market intelligence for product and GTM leaders. Five skills sharing one hardened research subagent that verifies quantitative claims against third-party sources and refuses instructions embedded in fetched pages. Compare 3 to 8 entities side by side, brief one company in depth, build a competitive landscape and battle card as styled HTML, run a competitive wedge analysis against a named rival, or prepare for a specific commercial call.

plugins.name: ai-adoption-os
plugins.description: Turn AI curiosity into a working plan at a 25 to 150 person company. Four skills an operator runs in sequence or standalone: inventory the tool stack and find where AI fits, survey employees to surface the AI use already happening, build a prompt cookbook for your actual vertical, and assemble an internal enablement course from the results. Each interviews you first and produces a completed document, not a blank template.
